plain: Helped or encouraged someone to commit a crime

webster.text: Incited, aided, encouraged to a crime.

example.quote: It ought never to be forgotten, that a firm union of this country, under an efficient government, will probably be an increasing object of jealousy to more than one nation of Europe; and that enterprises to subvert it will sometimes originate in the intrigues of foreign powers, and will seldom fail to be patronized and abetted by some of them.
